description: A high-ceilinged flat with a picture rail and a boarded-up fireplace. A kitchenette fills the old scullery. From up here you watch the lights come on round the Basin. In the afternoon the light off the water goes gold on the picture rail. The bathroom is through a panelled door at the back.

window.description: A tall sash window with the city spread out under it.
window.name: the sash window

name: Corbett Mansions, Unit 12A
